candidates.text_raw: The Arwic Explorer has charged you to prove your mastery of the Ringway system by touching the Ruby, Sapphire, and Emerald Obelisks of this region.

Press M to open your map panel to see where you are right now. Use your map panel and your compass to find the Arwic Ringway to North Outpost portal at 45.5 N, 7.5 W. After you've passed through, use the Ruby Obelisk on the other side.

Press M to open your map panel to see where you are right now. Use your map panel and your compass to find the Arwic Ringway to East Outpost portal at 46.9 N, 0 E. After you've passed through, use the Sapphire Obelisk on the other side.

Press M to open your map panel to see where you are right now. Use your map panel and your compass to find the Arwic Ringway to South Outpost portal at 42.1 N, 8.5 E. When you've passed through, use the Emerald Obelisk on the other side.
The Arwic Explorer will be pleased to see your progress! Use the Arwic Ringway to Arwic Town portal at 34.3N, 2 W to return to him and receive your reward.
The Lost Wish Explorer has charged you to prove your mastery of the Ringway system by touching the Ruby, Sapphire, and Emerald Obelisks of this region.

Press M to open your map panel to see where you are right now. Use your map panel and your compass to find the Lost Wish Ringway to Northwest Outpost portal at 44.2 N, 11.3 E. After you've passed through, use the Ruby Obelisk on the other side.

Press M to open your map panel to see where you are right now. Use your map panel and your compass to find the Lost Wish Ringway to Northeast Outpost portal at 53.1 N, 9.9 E. After you've passed through, use the Sapphire Obelisk on the other side.

Press M to open your map panel to see where you are right now. Use your map panel and your compass to find the Lost Wish Ringway to Southeast Outpost portal at 53.5 N, 19.0 E. After you've passed through, use the Emerald Obelisk on the other side.
The Lost Wish Explorer will be pleased to see your progress! Use the Lost Wish Ringway to Town of Kehan portal at 47.3 N, 21.4 E to return to her and receive your reward.
The Esper Explorer has charged you to prove your mastery of the Ringway system by touching the Ruby, Sapphire, and Emerald Obelisks of this region.

Press M to open your map panel to see where you are right now. Use your map panel and your compass to find the Esper Ringway to Northwest Outpost portal at 45.1 N, 14.6 W. When you've passed through, use the Ruby Obelisk on the other side.

Press M to open your map panel to see where you are right now. Use your map panel and your compass to find the Esper Ringway to Southwest Outpost portal at 41.2 N, 25.9 W. When you've passed through, use the Sapphire Obelisk on the other side.

Press M to open your map panel to see where you are right now. Use your map panel and your compass to find the Esper Ringway to Millstone Town portal at 29.8 N, 24.8 W. When you've passed through, use the Emerald Obelisk on the other side.
The Esper Explorer will be pleased to see your progress! Use the Esper Ringway to Northeast Outpost portal  at 37.8 N, 19.8 W to return to him and receive your reward.

With the right components, you too can brew a powerful Broth of Tanacha!

Gather the broth's components and place them in the Cauldron of Tanacha.
You must do all of the following:

With the right components, you too can brew a powerful Broth of Tanacha!

Use the Cauldron to brew the Broth of Tanacha.
Take the Fierce Sandy Armoredillo Scales.
Give the Fierce Sandy Armoredillo Scales to the Cauldron of Tanacha.
Give the Shear Beetle Flesh to the Cauldron of Tanacha.
Give the Reedshark Elder Tendon to the Cauldron of Tanacha.
Give the Hamekh Scraven Oil to the Cauldron of Tanacha.
Give the Carrion Shreth Blood to the Cauldron of Tanacha.

An unnatural strength sings in your veins! You must slaughter the hated Sclavi! Death will remove the power of the unguent, and the quest will fail.

Slay the following:

Strike a blow against the Drudges' former masters.

Kill a Burun Slavetaker in the canyons around the King Toad Idol (2.5N, 17.8E).

Strike a blow against the Drudges' former masters.

Take the Slavetaker's head from his corpse.

Strike a blow against the Drudges' former masters.

Give the Slavetaker's head to a New Drudge Republic Counselor.

Infuse the shrines with the life essence of the Deru tree.

Use the following shrines:

Infuse the shrines with the life essence of the Deru tree.

Return to the Great Shrine of the Deru and use it.

The petrified heart of a Tyrant is reputed to have magical power when rejuvenated with fresh Tyrant blood.

Infuse the stone Tyrant heart with the blood of five types of Tyrant: Spindrift, Crag, Cloud, Squall, and Storm.

The opal from the Mist Shrine has cracked. It must be mended. Be careful not to die before you complete this quest, or the magic of resurrection will disrupt the opal, and the quest will fail!

Go to the Mist Caverns and give the Cracked Opal to the Misty Fount.

The opal from the Mist Shrine has cracked. It must be mended. Be careful not to die before you complete this quest, or the magic of resurrection will disrupt the opal, and the quest will fail!

Go back to the Mist Shrine and give it the mended Opal.

Return the lost emerald to the Totem of Vakentu.

Bring the Emerald to the Totem of Vakentu without dying.
Protect your fellow, tasked to retrieve the Emerald of Vakentu.

The Spirit of Artefun seeks the doctrines of the three kingdoms

Obtain the following doctrines for the Spirit of Artefun:

The Spirit of Artefun seeks the doctrines of the three kingdoms

Give the following doctrines to the Spirit of Artefun:

The Spirit of Artefun seeks the doctrines of the three kingdoms

Use the Spirit of Artefun to gain your reward.

Despoil the Drudges' idols to the Burun. You must do this without dying to please Rashan Twoblades!

Use the following idols to despoil them, without dying. Each will curse you, but completing the quest will lift all three curses.

Despoil the Drudges' idols to the Burun. You must do this without dying to please Rashan Twoblades!

Return to Rashan's spectre without dying and claim your prize!

Find a way to lift the corruption from the burial mound of Unaro.

Do the following:

Find a way to lift the corruption from the burial mound of Unaro.

Slay at least one Opor Nefane.

Find a way to lift the corruption from the burial mound of Unaro.

Bring the ichor of an Opor Nefane to the spirit of Hakemi at Unaro's burial mound.
Slay at least one Listris Niffis
Bring the ichor of a Listris Niffis to the spirit of Hakemi at Unaro's burial mound.
Slay at least one Glissna Niffis
Bring the ichor of a Glissna Niffis to the spirit of Hakemi at Unaro's burial mound.
Slay at least one Opor Niffis
Bring the ichor of a Opor Niffis to the spirit of Hakemi at Unaro's burial mound.

The Banderlings have been stealing Armoredillo eggs. Kill these rustlers for the Eli Spinekeepers.

Slay the following:

The Banderlings have been stealing Armoredillo eggs. Kill these rustlers for the Eli Spinekeepers.

Return to an Eli Spinekeeper with word of your success.

Lodrog the Forsaken, a renegade Gurog, has given you a geas: bring him revenant thighbones for his research into the undead.

Do the following:

Lodrog the Forsaken, a renegade Gurog, has given you a geas: bring him revenant thighbones for his research into the undead.

Speak to Lodrog to receive your reward.
Pick up a fresh Revenant Conscript thighbone.
Give the thighbone to Lodrog the Forsaken.
Pick up a fresh Revenant Legionary thighbone.
Give the thighbone to Lodrog the Forsaken.
Pick up a fresh Revenant Prefect thighbone.
Give the thighbone to Lodrog the Forsaken.

Retrieve the Ghostfire Gauntlets from the treasury of the Burun lord Eeruk.

Slay Eeruk of the Burun in the Deepdank tunnels.

Retrieve the Ghostfire Gauntlets from the treasury of the Burun lord Eeruk.

Retrieve the Ghostfire Gauntlets from Eeruk's treasury.

The Moarsman chief cursed you with his dying breath! You can lift the curse by destroying the hated Burun.

Slay the following:

Recover a Darkstone carried by the Gurog Emissaries.

Kill a Gurog Emissary near the Choker.

Recover a Darkstone carried by the Gurog Emissaries.

Take the Darkstone from the Gurog Emissary's corpse.

Recover a Darkstone carried by the Gurog Emissaries.

Give the Faded Darkstone to the Ancestor.

Recover a Darkstone carried by the Gurog Emissaries.

Slay a Burun Immortal.

Recover a Darkstone carried by the Gurog Emissaries.

Return to the Ancestor to remove the curse.
The Lost Wish Explorer will teach you more about the Ringway portals of your new land.
The Lost Wish can be found at 43.9 N,  11.2 E.
Drudges have infiltrated the Shelter Hold. Speak to the Shelter Guards within the Hold to discover how to stave them off.

Learn from the Training Stones

Double-click the first three training stones in this area to read them, then go speak to the Shelter Lieutenant.

The Guard told you, 'The Shelter is under attack! Drudge Diggers have penetrated the Shelter Hold. We must train you to help us fight them off.

Double-click the glowing Training Stones like the one behind me to learn how to survive in our much-changed world. When you have finished, speak to the Shelter Lieutenant!'

Learn Combat 

Read the next four Training Stones, then speak to the Shelter Sentry.

The Lieutenant told you, 'The Drudges, armed with ungodly weapons, drove the first wave of settlers back into the Shelters. They have been our sworn enemies ever since. The next Training Stones are down the tunnel. They will tell you what you need to know to defend our Holding. When you are finished, speak to the Shelter Sentry.'

Battle the Drudge Diggers. Take any tools you find on them to the Shelter Scout, who is further down the tunnel.

The Sentry told you, 'The Drudges are up ahead! We must find their weakness in order to fight them back. If you find a special tool on them, take it to the Shelter Scout. She has gone ahead to gather information.'

Talk to the Shelter Scout

Give the Imbued Digging Tool you just found to the Shelter Scout. Left-click the Tool in your Inventory, then drag it over to the Shelter Scout.

Fight the Drudge Sentinels and take their Glyphs.

The Scout told you, 'No paltry Drudge Digger could imbue a tool like this - the Sentinels ahead must be their leaders! They must have somehow obtained Glyphs to our Shelter Shard in order to have entered in such numbers. Fight a Sentinel, and take his Glyph. If he can use it to enter, you can use it to leave. But first, I must bolster your strength.'

Enter the Menhir Shard Room

Use the Menhir Glyph to enter the Menhir Shard Room. Double-click the glyph, then click the Menhir Portal.

Talk to the Advance Shelter Scout

The Advance Shelter Scout has important informaton to give you before you leave for the wilds of Dereth.

Double-click the Menhir Shard

To leave this place, double-click the Menhir Shard. There are many more like it across the land - and like this one, they all hold many secrets.

The Advance Scout told you, 'By depriving the Drudge Sentinels of their Glyphs, you have done your part to stave off the Drudge threat. You are now ready to reclaim our ancestors' world from our enemies. Put the Shelters behind you, and reclaim your rightful home. Once you leave, seek out one of the Explorers -- they will show you the way to travel through the land.'
The Explorer mentioned that a friend in Arwic is having a terrible time with the Drudges. Find him, and perhaps he will tell you his sorry tale.

Find the Arwic Overseer in Arwic town at 44 N, 6.1 W.

The Ringway Explorer told you, \qYou have proven you have mastered the Ringway system. You'll find a set of Ringway portals like this one in every region. Further in your travels, you'll find green Gateway portals that will take you from region to region.\q
In return for clearing out the Drudges who have overrun the New Arwic Mines, the Mines Overseer has promised to reward you with crafting lessons and experience.

Leave town to the north and go east to the New Arwic Mines. Fight the Drudge Outcasts within to retrieve one of the miners' flat hammers.

The Overseer told you, \qArwic's rebuilding efforts have stalled! Supplies were cut off when the Drudge Outcasts overran my mines. The miners dropped their flat hammers during their escape. If you clear out the Drudges and return with a hammer, I will teach you the basics of crafting.\q
Return to the Arwic Mines Overseer.

Use the special quest recipe to craft an Arwic Mines Short Sword.

The Mines Overseer told you, \qClick on the Craft Tab in your Skill panel. I have put a recipe for an Arwic Mines Short sword into your Quest recipes. Examine it to learn how to make the sword. When you succeed, give it to me so I can inspect your progress!\q
The Mines Overseer told you, \qWhen you suceed in making the Arwic Mines Short Sword, give me the short sword so I can inspect your progress!\q
The Arwic Mines Overseer has a friend in Lost Wish who needs your help!

The Arwic Mines Overseer would like you to help his friend, the Miller of Kehan at 42.5 N, 11.2 E.

The Arwic Mines Overseer told you, \qBravo - perhaps I will use this to give those Drudges a good smiting! You've been such a help -- take this, with my thanks! Incidentally, perhaps you could help a friend of mine in Lost Wish? She's been battling the Drudge scourge over in her neck of the wood as well!\q
The poor Warder Scout has lost his notebook! Get it back from the mean nasty drudge who took it.
Find and kill the Drudge Slinker Bandit who ambushed the Warder Scout at 28.1 N x 3.9 E.
Take the notebook from the dead Drudge Slinker Bandit.
Bring the notebook back to the Warder Scout.
Seek out the Warder Captain in the Warder's Hideout at 20.6 N x 14 E.
Find the fort at 19.5 N x 21 E where the Drudges store their potions! Kill a guard and take its key.
Take the key of the Drudge Potion Guard you've killed.
Use the key on the Potion Chest and steal the Drudges' potion.
Bring the potion back to the Warder Captain in the Warder Hideout at 20.6N, 14.0E.
The Miller of Kehan desperately needs your help in repairing the family windmill to the north of Kehan.

Obtain a pile of Stone for the Miller.

The Miller of Kehan told you, \qA roving band of Drudge Outcasts destroyed my Windmill! Could you help me repair it? I need a pile of Stone. Here, follow this map to find a Stone Quarry, then harvest some Stone and bring it to me. (If you need a Rock Hammer, you can make one yourself -- look under 'Starter Tools' in your Toolmaking panel.)\q
Harvest some Stone with a Rock Hammer, then give it to the Miller of Kehan.

Place the gear in the Windmill to the north of Kehan.

The Miller of Kehan told you, \qI will now create a Windmill gear - the Drudges destroyed the old one. Please place it inside the Windmill to repair it!\q
Now that you have repaired the Miller of Kehan's family Windmill, she will surely reward you.
Obtain a bar of Iron from the Ore Mine at 41.4 N, 14.1 E.
Obtain a pile of stone from the Stone Quarry at 38.3 N, 12.7 E.
Obtain a pile of logs from the Logging Camp at 40.1 N, 13.7 E.

The Miller of Kehan believes the Esper Reaches Warder in Millstone at 37.5 N, 19.9 W has news that would interest you.

The Miller of Kehan told you, \qThank you for restoring my Windmill. I've heard that these glyphs are the key to unlock the secrets of this region - take this, with my thanks! And now, you should speak with my associate in the Esper Reaches. He's sent word that he might know who's behind all this Drudge activity we've been seeing lately.\q
Find Dantry, the founder and leader of the Warders, at 7.4 N x 15.4 E in the Prosper Marches.
Find a Warder of Osteth in Cragstone.

The Esper Warder would like you to give the Warder in Cragstone at 32.2 N, 12.5 W his regards.

The Esper Warder told you, \qI knew my friend the Miller was correct in sending you to me. You have proven yourself worthy of the Warders of Osteth's regard. Let me reward you with experience and this Glyph. The Menhir it allows access to will tell you a few secrets of this land's history. If you should pass on to Cragstone, please give a friend of mine my regards. She is watching over the city of Cragstone even now.\q
The Esper Warder has enlisted your aid in eradicating the Drudge threat from this region.

Use a Drudge Slayer quest recipe to create a special weapon.

The Esper Warder told you, \qThe Warders have discovered the hidden Drudge Outcast headquarters on the island southeast of Millstone. I will give you quest recipes for weapons that will be especially effective against their Cadre. If you use one of these weapons to kill a Cadre member and bring back his bones, I will reward you.

Journey to the island southeast of Millstone to purge Esper of the Drudge Outcast Cadre. The Esper Warder has promised to reward you for slaying the Cadre with a special Cadre Slayer weapon. Bring back one of the Cadre's bones for your reward.
The Esper Warder has promised to reward you if you bring back one of the Drudge Cadre's bones.
The warder of Cragstone has entrusted you with the mission to discover what the Drudges are looking for down in the Old Cragstone Excavation.

Journey to the depths of the Old Cragstone Excavation to discover what the Drudges are looking for.

The Warder in Cragstone told you, \qThe Drudges have been ransacking the Old Cragstone Excavation -- we must intercept anything they might have found. Journey to the excavation and interrogate any Drudges you may find. If any of them refuse to parley, you have the Warder's permission to confiscate their goods! I strongly encourage you to join a fellowship for this dangerous mission.\q
There are three fragments to the seal. Find all three and use your quest recipe to fuse them together. Only one fellowship member needs to complete the seal.
Use the Library Seal to gain access to the Old Cragstone Library. Only one member of a fellowship need use the seal for all members to enter the portal.
The Warder in Cragstone charged you not only to encounter the Drudges, but to find what the Drudges were looking for as well.
Take the Cragstone Blueprints back to the Warder in Cragstone.
Seek the Aste Sclavus Preceptor located in a fort at 11.0 N, 54.8 E.
Seek the Essa Sclavus Preceptor located in a fort at 6.5 N, 58.1 E.
Seek the Sata Sclavus Preceptor located in a fort at 11.0 S, 69.5 E.
Seek the Ulu Sclavus Preceptor located in a fort at 2.3 S, 77.6 E.
Seek the Faisi Sclavus Hierophant in the Faisi Sclavus Hierophant's Dungeon, at 8.8 N, 67.9 E.
Bring the Faisi Sclavus Hierophant's Talisman to Seskri the Sclavus Scholar.
Speak to the Sclavus Scholar to receive your reward.
Speak to the Warder Scout to receive your reward.
Speak to the Warder Captain to receive your reward.
Seek out Kartok, the ghost of a Lugian scout. He is being held in a crypt beneath the Silent City.
Seek out Degoda, the Lord of Linvak Tukal. He is being held in a crypt beneath the Yokketh Bell Tower.
Return to the Elder Scholar for further information.
Combine Degoda’s spirit with Kartok’s worn boots using the recipe taught to you by the Elder Scholar.
Obtain Sapphires from the Mines of Ulkas.
Kill Lord Deimos so your fellowship may collect his scales.
Collect one of the flawless scales that has dropped to the ground.
Dip your Alembic into one of the geysers that has erupted recently in western Ariaki, southeastern Farali, or eastern Oriad.
Use your recipe to create an Aconite potion.
Bring your Aconite potion back to Orlen.
Lahry the Farmer seems upset about something. Try and help him out, if you can.
Lahry hasn't told you what's wrong yet. Talk to him again.
Lahry seems to be an excitable sort doesn't he? Talk to him again, maybe he'll tell you what's wrong.
Lahry mentioned something about the White Rabbit. Talk to him yet again to find out more.
Lahry tells a pretty tall tale, but there might be some truth to it. Talk to him even more to find out more.
Lahry has asked you to go into his abandoned underground farm to see what the White Rabbit is doing.
